'''Komi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an assistant to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[S. Geland]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Around [[3641 BBY]], Komi was present on the prison world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During a major breakout and rioting that the Empire caused, Komi contacted the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] for assistance. Later, she called Commander Geland on the holo to let him know that the Barsen'thor was arriving. Geland thanked her and began to kill everyone, forcing Komi to watch in horror. It turns out that Geland was a [[Children of the Emperor|child]] of the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]]. As the Barsen'thor arrived, Komi raised her weapon and shot the communication to prevent Geland from seeing. She revealed everything to the Jedi, but since Geland left his ID card, there was no way to track him. She went on to destroy the IDs of the dead victims.
